# Welcome

- [JavaScript Site Tricks](https://ipmingsum2.github.io/sitetricks/sitetricks.md): Welcome to the main menu of JavaScript site tricks. In this documentation, you will to have dev tools. If you're on mobile, don't worry, there's another way.
- [Alvin's Obfuscator](https://ipmingsum2.github.io/obfuscator/readme.md): Based on Prometheus by Elias Oelschner, https://github.com/prometheus-lua/Prometheus

- [Ad Board Installation](https://ipmingsum2.github.io/adboard/installation.md): Before getting started, insert the latest version of this product from our Discord into your game.

## External

### Chatbox

- [CHATBOX bot documentation](https://ipmingsum2.github.io/external/chatbox/bot-api.md): The readable HTML guide, examples, and chatbox.js download are at CHATBOX Developer Docs.
- [CHATBOX deployment](https://ipmingsum2.github.io/external/chatbox/deployment.md): The frontend stays on GitHub Pages and uses the existing Supabase project. No database export is required. Deploy the database and Edge Function before publishing the frontend.
